deep_analysis:
No open trades — the book is flat, so this cycle is about WHY we're flat and what the last 41 closes say about the next entry.

41 trades closed in the last 24h at 36.6% WR (15W/26L, LONG 15/36, SHORT 0/5). Every single dollar of profit came from exactly one exit path: profit-monster-trail (16 exits, 13W, +0.041 avg). Everything that never reached the trail arm lost: atr_sl_hit 0/10, hard_max_loss 0/6 (-0.117 avg), trail_arm_timeout 0/4, hard_sl 0/1. That's 20 trades — 49% of all closes — that never moved +0.40% and bled out. The edge in this system is not direction, it's momentum-at-entry: we win when the trade is immediately in profit and the trail arms, we lose when we enter and wait.

Are we on the right side? Mostly no. The 5m tape is SHORT_BIAS on 87 of 129 tokens, BTC 15m is SHORT_BIAS, ETH/XRP/SOL/AVAX all SHORT_BIAS with 77-87 confidence — and we opened 36 LONGs against it while the short generators returned zero signals. Both sides are actually losing here (SHORT 0/5), which is the honest picture: this is chop, not a trend we're fading. BTC sits AT its EMA300 (continuum AT), velocity SLOW, volume LOW, volatility LOW. In this regime nobody has edge except the trades that catch an immediate impulse. We were on neither side of the impulse — we were on the side that waits.

Meta-RSI split over 48h LONGs (n=41, meta_rsi from _signal_metadata): <45 = 2W/6 (-0.045 avg), 45-60 = 9W/25 (-0.030 avg), 60+ = 5W/10 (+0.034 avg). The band we tell ourselves is the 'sweet spot' (45-60) is the band that loses; the only profitable band is momentum-side RSI>60. Small samples — treat as a flag, not a law — but it points the same way as the exit data: momentum entries win, mid-band 'value' entries lose.
regime_context:
BTC: AT EMA300 (continuum 'AT', 83 ticks below), linreg LEAN_BEAR, trend_quality STRONG_UP on 1m but market_phase DECLINING, velocity SLOW, acceleration swinging NEGATIVE, volume LOW, volatility LOW, Wyckoff ACCUMULATION, 4h LONG_BIAS vs 15m SHORT_BIAS — a split, undecided tape.

5m aggregate: SHORT_BIAS 87 / LONG_BIAS 2 / NEUTRAL 40 (confidence 75+ shorts include ETH, AVAX, DOT, ICP, GRT, AERO, CASHCAT, STABLE). Only real longs: COMP (76.5) and TON (56).

Meaning for positions: flat is currently the correct posture. Low vol + SLOW velocity + AT-EMA300 = chop, the exact condition where hard_max_loss entries die (52/56 never arm the trail). Nothing here says reload longs; nothing here says pile into shorts either (SHORT 0/5 last 24h). The regime earns us patience, not a direction — and when it breaks, it breaks with volume: watch for BTC to leave the EMA300 band with volume_ratio > 1.5 on either side, and take the impulse, not the fade.
pattern_alerts:
VERIFIED (PostgreSQL, queried this cycle, meta_rsi from _signal_metadata — not entry_rsi_14):

1. TRAIL-MONOPOLY ON P&L — n=41 closes/24h. profit-monster-trail: 16, 13W, +0.041 avg. All non-trail exits combined: 20 trades, 0W, avg negative (atr_sl_hit 0/10, hard_max_loss 0/6 @ -0.117, trail_arm_timeout 0/4, hard_sl 0/1). WINNING SIDE = entries that are instantly in profit and arm the trail by +0.40%. Why weren't we on it: 49% of entries never reached +0.40% — we're entering between impulses, i.e. during chop, and paying the spread for the privilege.

2. LONG-INTO-SHORT-TAPE — n=36 LONG / 5 SHORT in 24h vs 5m regime SHORT_BIAS 87/129 and BTC 15m SHORT_BIAS. LONG WR 42% avg -0.018; SHORT WR 0% avg -0.074. Session brain confirms short generators return 0 signals while long factories (pump-chain+, r2v2, bb-bounce-v2) keep firing. WINNING SIDE = stand aside, or the short nobody is generating. We weren't on it because the signal book is structurally long-heavy — this is an inventory problem, not a per-trade problem.

3. pump-chain+ IS DEAD — n=8 closes/48h, 0W, -0.089 avg (worst signal by volume in the window). Its recent victims: INJ -3.67%, -3.44% (both hard_max_loss), both at meta_rsi ~50-55 mid-band. WINNING SIDE on those same coins: INJ is 5m SHORT_BIAS conf 95, slope -0.18 — the short was the right side both times.

4. MID-BAND LONGS LOSE, MOMENTUM LONGS WIN — 48h LONG by meta_rsi: <45 = 2W/6 (-0.045), 45-60 = 9W/25 (-0.030), 60+ = 5W/10 (+0.034). WINNING SIDE = RSI>60 momentum continuation. n is small (10-25 per band); this contradicts our standing 'enter 45-60' guidance and deserves an independent backtest before anyone tunes a filter on it (THE PATTERN rule — do not ship this on my numbers alone).

5. LOSERS' WINNING SIDE (last 24h, specifics): POL LONG -4.85% hard_max_loss (POL 5m SHORT_BIAS 80.3, right side = short); STX LONG -4.90% (meta_rsi 57.6 mid-band, right side = wait/fade); INJ LONG -3.67% (SHORT_BIAS 95 — right side = short); SYRUP LONG -3.09% stale_exit (SYRUP now ranging/neutral — right side = no trade). Every big loser maps to the same answer: the tape was already short and we bought it.
